verified.note: Table 2, "SSE data for L x L systems with open boundary conditions. The ground state energy is normalized by the number of interaction bonds N_b = 2(L^2 - L)", row L = 28. Printed as a magnitude; E/N = -(E0/N_b) N_b / N = -0.65448058 in S.S units, Pauli total = 4 N E/N. The L = 6 value agrees with the exact-diagonalization row on square_36_O to 3.3e-7 (2 sigma), and L = 10 and 16 reproduce the rows QMBL already quotes from this paper via arXiv:2605.13807.
